verdict.rationale: Fenwick has a dedicated Trademark practice page. It describes registering marks in 180+ jurisdictions, prosecuting more than 32,000 applications and registrations, and handling over 3,500 active trademark disputes, which covers registration and enforcement. A custom trademark extranet for portfolio, docket and dispute management backs this up. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of trademark clearance/search work, and independent (non-firm) corroboration of the practice.
